evidence_excerpt: DIB Chat Bot ... enabled with artificial intelligence (AI features)
evidence_summary: DIB's official FY2018 results state that the bank introduced an AI-enabled chatbot providing customer support on queries and transactions during 2018.
source_locator: FY2018 Group Financial Results > digital capabilities highlights
adoption_interpretation: Operational AI is observed in the first year of the target panel, so adoption is left-censored at <=2018. DIB should not be assigned a post-2018 first-adoption date for staggered-adoption analysis.
notes: Score 2: production customer-support use is explicit, but this record alone does not show core credit/risk decision integration.

evidence_summary: DIB officially joined the commercial UAE Trade Connect platform, which uses AI capabilities to prevent fraud and duplication, detect dubious trade-finance transactions and validate trade-related documents.
adoption_interpretation: Confirms persistent operational AI use by 2022; does not change the left-censored <=2018 adoption status.
notes: Conservative score 2 because the AI capability resides in a shared commercial platform used by DIB; the evidence establishes operational use but not that DIB itself controls the model architecture.
